client.name: Super Mario Odyssey Client
client._kind_source: README: the mod inside the game connects OUT to a Connector. Nothing of ours reads the console's or the emulator's memory -- the game does the talking. This is why no Switch memory bridge is needed or claimed.
client._protocol_source: the world opens its own connection to the game -- no emulator memory protocol is involved, so London carries nothing but the launch. Recorded as "self" rather than naming a bridge we do not use.

apworld._source: README: "Install the latest version from the releases page"; latest v1.6.3

_install_kind_source: README: smo.apworld into custom_worlds, plus SMO_Archipelago_Vx.x_Switch.zip (atmosphere folder onto the SD card) or _Emu.zip (SMOAP folder into the emulator's mods directory).
setup: Download smo.apworld and either the Switch or the Emu zip from the release.
Put smo.apworld in Archipelago's custom_worlds folder.
Console: extract the Switch zip and put the atmosphere folder at the root of your SD card.
Emulator: extract the Emu zip and put the SMOAP folder in the emulator's mods directory.
Start the game and enter the room's address when it prompts.

patch._source: the setup guide describes no patching step

_patch_extension_source: world source not downloaded -- repo policy is addresses only. Flagged in every build until somebody reads it.

credits._note: Super Mario Odyssey is Nintendo's and is never distributed here; the player supplies their own copy. The mod and the world are Kgamer77's and Adi's. Only the plugin itself is by solida1987.

_warning: The mod works ONLY on Super Mario Odyssey version 1.0.0 -- the README says so in capitals. A player on any later update will install everything correctly and find that nothing works.
